criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: Official Purdue GIS feature 915 identifies BLDG_ABBR LSR, BUILDING_N Life Science Ranges, address 180 S Russell Street. The saved aerial and GIS overlay locate the feature on the greenhouse complex; board Exhibit A names the facility and ranges.
criteria.findings: Identity and footprint are strongly supported. GIS feature has an outer ring and an internal ring; builder traces the envelope curb and draws range rows from the aerial.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.evidence: Builder projects lon/lat into the project's local XY convention and derives origin from FID 915 bounds. Projected GIS envelope is 94.75 m E-W by 122.18 m N-S; model bounds are 95.10 by 122.40 m (delta +0.35, +0.22 m). Rows are drawn in the same east-west orientation as the orthophoto.
criteria.findings: Asset-local dimensions and axes closely match GIS, but the candidate evidence does not verify the corresponding master placement marker or a direct top-down overlay of the new candidate geometry against GIS. The yellow outline in the saved overlay is explicitly the old massing bounds.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: Purdue GIS records NUM_LEVELS=2 and Extrution=12 (the field's units/meaning are not documented in the saved evidence). The aerial, board plan, and Purdue photos support low multi-span pitched greenhouse roofs and a service wing.
criteria.findings: Builder uses 3.65 m eaves, 5.95 m greenhouse ridge, and 6.8 m service-wing height without a dimensioned section/elevation or verified interpretation of the GIS Extrution field. These are estimates; roof appearance is plausible but measured height and exact roof geometry remain unsupported.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.evidence: 2026 Purdue exterior photo shows glazed greenhouse framing, low opaque base, attached brick/service portion and facility sign. Conveyor photo supports the phenotyping equipment concept. Renders show glazing, repeated frames, service doors, louvers, sign and planted benches.
criteria.findings: Distinctive materials and greenhouse structure are recognizable. Some service-wing facade/entrance proportions and equipment placement are reconstructed from limited views rather than dimensioned or surveyed evidence; interior benches/plants are a plausible interpretation.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: Expected SHA-256 match: True. Fresh-open report passes with 49 objects, 17 materials and 0 unpacked external image dependencies; expected scene/collection names are present. Required preview/source files: 12/12 present.
criteria.findings: Modular collection and clean reopen are verified. Evidence is substantial, but the saved source notes do not consistently record exact source URLs/provider retrieval dates/source dates/CRS/method/uncertainty per AGENT.md. The existing overlay is not a candidate-asset-vs-GIS validation.
